aboutPage.title: About the Project
aboutPage.description: RickVerse Search is a React application that allows users to explore characters from the Rick and Morty universe. It fetches character data from the Rick and Morty API and displays it in a user-friendly interface. Users can browse through characters, view their details, and navigate through different pages of results.
aboutPage.authorDescription: Frontend developer and student building this project as part of a React learning journey. Focused on clean UI, reusable components and async data handling.
aboutPage.mentorDescription: Guided the project architecture, shared best practices and helped improve code quality and component structure.
aboutPage.courseDescription: This project was created during a frontend course focused on modern React development, component-based architecture and practical application building.
